scenes.headline: How one contract serves 365,000 RL environments
scenes.sub: Prime Intellect's taskset API, and what changes when the reward is taste.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wasabi! Agent training is simple: act, check, reward. The hard part is the check. Here's how Prime Intellect scales it.

scenes.text: Put 23 tasksets behind one contract: a prebuilt sandbox per task, grading hidden until scoring, and a gold and no-op check before anything is trusted.
scenes.say: Twenty-three tasksets, one contract: a prebuilt sandbox per task, grading hidden until scoring, and a gold and no-op check before anything is trusted.

steps.say: Verifiers v1 splits an environment into three layers. The taskset holds the data and scoring. All twenty-three load through one API.
The harness drives the agent; the runtime is where it runs. Any taskset, any harness, any runtime, one command.

scenes.title: A rollout, end to end
scenes.say: Every rollout walks the same hooks, with the agent sharing a sandbox with its grader.

items.say: Setup boots the task's prebuilt image.
The agent works with the grader hidden, since anything readable invites a reward hack.
Then the tests are restored, and the taskset's own grader scores it.

steps.say: Before a taskset is trusted, its gold patch must pass the full scoring path, with failures retried up to ten times.
Then a no-edit run. A task solved without any work is reward-hack fuel, so it's dropped, and kept for audit.
For the noisiest sources, most rows don't survive. One loses eighty percent.

left.title: Verified reward
items: A hidden test passes or fails
Gold and no-op runs prove it
left.say: Code has a fact to check: a hidden test passes, or it doesn't.

right.title: Reward over taste
items: An honesty gate, then model judges
178 hand-rated paintings are the ground truth
right.say: The watercolour environment has no gold patch. Past an honesty gate, judge models score each painting.

scenes.text: Agentic RL fails on thousands of tiny reward bugs, so treat environments as manufactured, validated artifacts.

recap: Taskset, harness and runtime are separate layers
Gold and no-op runs gate every task
scenes.say: To recap: three layers, grading hidden until scoring, and a gold and no-op gate on every task.
